title: Depth bound for paired circuits
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $b$ specify either an AND or an OR gate, and let $cs$ be a list of circuits on $n$ variables. Pair consecutive circuits in $cs$ into gates of type $b$, leaving a final unpaired circuit unchanged when the list has odd length. The maximum depth in the resulting list is at most one plus the maximum depth in $cs$, where the maximum over an empty list is $0$.
hypotheses_covered: $cs$ is a list of circuits on $n$ variables
